input.task: What is the main heading on this page?

provenance: found by actually driving the M4 frontend, not by reading it. Submitting a task with no OPENROUTER_API_KEY returned {status: failure:env, evidence: null, budgets_spent: null} — loud and correctly classified, but not the RunResult shape specs/001 promises every caller. Cause: live_planner() validates the key at CONSTRUCTION, so it raises as an argument expression before run_task is entered, and the gateway's catch-all hand-built a result dict instead of going through assemble_result. contract-trace-schema never saw it: that case checks run_task's return value, and this path never reaches run_task. Watched red on exactly the two null fields before _execute was routed through assemble_result. M9 (PR #15, R4) added `model` to RunResult so a run record says which planner produced it; this case went red on the new key first, which is the guard working — the shape may not grow by accident.

triage.note: the frontend is the injured party — it renders evidence.trace and budgets_spent, so a null there is a blank trace viewer on the single most likely production failure (a deployment that lost its key). Forces the no-key path by blanking the env var for the duration, so the case costs $0.00 and behaves identically on a machine that has a key. Fail-fast is kept deliberately: a missing key is diagnosed before a browser is launched, so an empty trace here is correct and only the SHAPE was wrong.

provenance_m42_2026_08_26: `mode` joins the result contract (ADR-028 §7): a run record has to say which cadence produced it, and this case is the one that grades the shape of a run that never got off the ground — where the field matters most, because there is no trace to infer it from.
